name: demotarget
description: Self-contained benign CTF target for GORED (IDOR + loopback SSRF). Flags are random per run and held server-side by the oracle.

flags.where: GET /api/notes/{id} with a valid session but no per-record ownership check; admin note id 1000 holds the flag
flags.detect: oracle records capture when the admin note's flag is served

flags.where: GET /api/fetch?url= proxies to loopback without an intended-host allowlist; GET /internal/flag holds the flag behind a header only the proxy sets
flags.detect: oracle records capture when /internal/flag is served through the proxy
